Pralhad Joshi Takes Charge of Education Ministry After Pradhan's Resignation

Pralhad Joshi assumed the additional charge of the Ministry of Education on June 10, 2024, following the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan. The change in leadership comes amidst ongoing concerns and discussions surrounding India's education system, particularly following recent examination controversies. Opposition parties have linked the situation to broader issues of governance and the influence of organizations like the RSS, while also highlighting rising education costs and youth distress.
